games.name: TOMB HUNT
games.note: Multi-platform levels (GnG staircase), stomp-to-kill guards, arc-gravity arrows, enemy darts. Approved 2026-06-20.

games.name: BOMB GARDEN
games.note: Plant bombs to stop zombie waves. Cross between Bomberman blast radius and PvZ lane defence.

games.name: CRUSHTRIS
games.note: 2×2 square = bomb (3×3 blast), 5-in-line = wrapped candy, 6+ = colour bomb. Tap-select CC swap mode.

games.name: PAC-LEMMING
games.note: Pac-Man eats pellets while lemmings cross the maze. Power pellets frighten ghosts + boost lem speed. 10/15 lems to win.

games.name: BOMB-LEMMINGS
games.note: Save lemmings by bombing dirt walls open. Bomberman (gravity+jump+bombs). 3 ghost enemies. 10/15 lems to win.

games.name: LEMMING-INVADERS
games.note: Shoot down Space Invaders before bombs kill lemmings below. 3 shield bunkers. 12/20 lems to win.

games.name: ASTRO-HOP
games.note: Double jump + coyote time + moving platforms + semi-platforms (hold down to drop through).

games.name: CAVE-PLUNGE
games.note: Wall slide + wall jump. Cave explorer + bats + crystal platforms + gem collectibles.

games.name: JUNGLE-HOP
games.note: Monkey + snake + mossy logs + treasure chest goal. TWT-inspired clean design.

games.name: LUPO ALBERTO
games.note: Platform mechanics template — wolf+dog+hearts. Based on C64 1990. Reskin = change sprites/palette only.
